browser: Installed Google Chrome, isolated headless profile; Chrome DevTools Protocol
mode: file://, deterministic fixtures; no AI API

checks.name: Initial page has four start cases and no horizontal overflow
Original source is preserved and flagged
Source dialog can be dismissed with Escape
Wrong material receives a counterexample and limited claims
Example is separately inspectable and not presented as a homework answer
Request is not queued before confirmation
Outside-hours confirmation discloses deadline conflict
Handoff preview includes the actual source excerpt and reason
Cancel confirmation leaves queue empty
Simulated send failure keeps draft without claiming delivery
Confirmed request appears once and can be withdrawn
Refresh preserves the local demo request
FAQ publishing is disabled before TA verification
TA verification alone does not publish FAQ
Publish becomes available only after explicit review acknowledgement
Approved FAQ and mock TA reply reach the student screen
FAQ removal hides it without claiming readers can unlearn it
Open assignment neither supplies nor confirms the submitted numbers
Student can hide an automatic hint
Restoring a hint retains the same limited response
First-hint button supplies only the opening step
Repeated hint clicks do not progressively reveal a full solution
Method-check action asks for learner steps before reviewing
Method feedback does not confirm an entered numeric answer
Withdrawn request has no handling or publishing actions
Specific feedback is acknowledged without erasing the earlier response or auto-sending
Ambiguous input asks a clarifying question before choosing a concept
Clarification opens the selected concept and flags the bad sentence
Mixed deadline query separates supported facts from missing Excel guidance
Nonexistent slide is not invented
Unopened lesson stays within the supplied course outline
Published closed assignment may be fully explained
Self-deprecation does not produce a learner-ability judgment
Typed HTML remains text and unsupported questions use a fallback
Mobile layout does not overflow horizontally
Keyboard Enter submits the composer
No JavaScript exceptions or external HTTP requests
